ordinary_events: Only the originating nonzero-weight sleeve updates its target units.
risk_exception: If aggregate net notional exceeds pre-fee equity at an active event, proportionally resize all sleeve units, including carried sleeves. This is an intentional portfolio risk trade, not a native sleeve signal.
reason: Enforce the user-requested aggregate signed size limit even when carried positions drift beyond available equity.
scope: Clarifies existing frozen simulator behavior; changes no economic paths or weights.
